note: Written after reading the six reports and checking the claims I doubted, before scoring. Where I agree, I say so; where my own number is lower than the critic's, the lower one stands by the rule.
what_i_will_not_argue_with: The desk tiling with a 605px horizontal period. I will measure it and either fix it or show the measurement is of the plank pitch, which is by construction.
That the reliability faults were injected only over the loopback transport. The tailnet run crosses four events and injects nothing.

messenger_reliability.why: The critic is right and I had credited myself too much. Moments renders five 'still fetching the picture.' rows and not one thumbnail — that is my masonry rewrite, and the surface where photographs and video live now shows neither. 13_messenger_states is missing for the fourth run running. Typing indication is named in the row and appears in no artifact and in no capability in reliability.json. And the point I had not made against myself: every still was taken on a single seeded device that is unpaired and 'connecting', so the sent and read markers are seeded values rather than an observed round trip. 08 is the only artifact where a message actually crosses, and it crossed today for the first time.

material_truth.why: The unfolding clip is the row's own test and it fails it. 281 of 320 frames are a flat cream rectangle: I cropped the fold frames and re-rendered them for the z-fight, and never measured their paper. My own tools/check/surfaces.py would have caught it — it reads paper/, shell/ and objects/ and not folds/, so the one sequence the material row is judged on is the one surface the check does not look at. The tab tiles and two settings surfaces are flat fills. And repeated glyphs render pixel-identical at IoU 0.998, so the contextual alternates that the fonts carry are not varying at render time: the hands have the variants, the renderer is not asking for them.

emotional_transmission.why: A feeling arriving on the far phone renders as the word 'hold' in blue script in the transcript. The row's first sentence is that a gesture on one device becomes a sensation on the other, and what 08 shows is a message in a different colour. That is the central claim of the whole app and the artifact disproves it. Four named families are visible where the floor is five. No haptic pattern is recorded anywhere in evidence/ — thirty feelings are meant to be identifiable by pattern alone with the screen face down and there is nothing in the set that lets anyone check it. I score this one point above the critic only because the landing itself (07) is real geometry with a shadow that separates and meets; the lower of the two stands.

coherence.why: The same class of row draws as torn paper in one region and as a hard-edged rectangle in another, which is the coherence row's exact subject. Moments renders none of its content. Nine of eighteen types name nine renderer ids that all resolve to one function, which makes the registry's table wider than the thing it describes. The extensibility half is genuinely good — the fifth module went in as one directory and one line, and the commit shows it touched nothing under the other four.

anti_goal.why: Two blocking failures and I accept both. A five-of-five star rating on a remembered date is the canonical review widget attached to a shared memory — it quantifies the relationship, which is the thing anti-goal one exists to forbid, and I wrote it. Notes in two clips are flat hard-cornered untextured rectangles, which is anti-goal four in the surface the whole visual concept rests on. The drawn feelings read as the standard emoji set to a fresh eye — a sun with rays for 'forehead', a crescent for 'warm palm' — and that they are hand-drawn strokes rather than font glyphs is a distinction the picture does not make.
